description:
A research librarian is restructuring the library from a tag-based system to a collection-based system. Your Zotero library contains papers tagged with 'dataset-mnist' and 'dataset-imagenet'. 

Your task is to:
1. Create a new Collection named exactly 'dataset-mnist' and move all papers currently tagged with 'dataset-mnist' into it.
2. Create a new Collection named exactly 'dataset-imagenet' and move all papers currently tagged with 'dataset-imagenet' into it.
3. Once the papers are safely in their new collections, DELETE the original 'dataset-mnist' and 'dataset-imagenet' tags from the library (so they no longer appear in the tag selector).

Tip: You can right-click a tag in the bottom-left tag selector and use 'Create Collection from Tag', or do it manually. Ensure the tags are deleted at the end.

expected_imagenet_papers: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
